newsitem.title: USA: Tropical Depression Kyle dissipates over C.America.
newsitem.headline: Tropical Depression Kyle dissipates over C.America.

text.p: Tropical Depression Kyle dissipated on Saturday just after hitting land in Central America, sparing the region what forcecasters had feared might be a serious lashing.
Kyle dissipated early in the afternoon just inland from the coast at the Honduran-Guatemalan border, the National Hurricane Centre said.
Earlier it had been downgraded from a Tropical Storm. Its final position after its drive west through the Caribbean Sea was latitude 15.6 north and longitude 88.4 west.
Kyle's remnants were dumping scattered showers and thunderstorms over the area, the centre said.
It grew out of stormy weather left behind by last week's Tropical Storm Josephine, which pushed through northern Florida and along the U.S. Eastern seaboard.
